svg.text: REPUBLIC OF THE PHILIPPINES | DEPARTMENT OF EDUCATION | REGION I | SDO ILOCOS NORTE
DepEd Institutional Brand Guidelines, Typography, Geometry & Visual Design Tokens

g.text: 1. OFFICIAL DEPED COLOR PALETTE & DESIGN TOKENS
Used for approved applications, section capacity safe (<35), active terms.
Used for pending registrar review, section capacity warning (35-39 learners).
Used for 40-student quota cap reached, schedule conflicts, invalid inputs.
Used for active navigation tabs, stepper progress markers, link actions.
• Contrast ratio between text and surface strictly exceeds 4.5:1 for normal body text and 3:1 for large headers.
• Pure White (#FFFFFF) text on DepEd Navy (#002060) achieves a contrast ratio of 14.8:1 (AAA Compliance).
2. GEOMETRY, ELEVATION & BORDER RADIUS TOKENS (4PX STANDARD)
• All cards, input fields, modals, and buttons use 4px-6px radius.
• Creates an authoritative, professional, government look.
Pill buttons evoke playful consumer apps and degrade institutional trust.
• Shadows are subtly tinted with navy hue (0, 32, 96).
• All component margins and padding align to multiples of 4px:
• 4px (p-1): Micro gaps between icon and text.
• 8px (p-2): Padding for status badges, small buttons.
• 16px (p-4): Standard padding for form input cells and list items.
• 24px (p-6): Card body padding across all dashboard panels.
Ensures visual rhythm and pixel-perfect vertical alignment.
CSS Token: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;
Card Label & Form Input Header (12px Medium / #334155)
STRICT INSTITUTIONAL MANDATE: ZERO DECORATIVE EMOJIS
Decorative emojis are completely barred from all UI views, portals, and official documents.
1. Dumal-NEXT produces legal basic education records (DepEd SF-1, SF-2, Form 138).
2. Operating systems render emojis inconsistently across Windows, iOS, and Android.
3. Emojis break strict screen reader accessibility hierarchies for visually-impaired users.
Strictly utilize stroke-based SVG icons from Lucide React:
Min height 42px on mobile to guarantee easy tapping without miss-clicks.
Focus ring: 2px solid #002060 with 2px offset; prevents losing cursor position.
Split modal allows registrar to inspect PSA scan at 200% zoom without leaving queue.
